marine.title: Forecast for Tonight and Sunday.
marine.text:
Wind southeast 15 knots veering to southwest 10 to 15 after
midnight then to west 20 late Sunday morning. Wind increasing to west 25 Sunday
evening. Scattered flurries Sunday. Fog patches forming early this
evening and dissipating Sunday morning. Temperatures near minus 2. <br/>
